thread:
alisa: Quick sync: chart feedback from support. Two issues: unit switching is confusing, and clipped spikes disappear. Any proposals?
jon: For units: add an explicit unit badge on the y-axis title (e.g., "Latency (auto)") with a small chevron to open a unit picker: Auto / ms / s / raw. When Auto changes the visible unit, show a transient toast: "Units switched to ms (auto)".
kevin: Clipping: instead of flattening, render a small chevron marker at the clip threshold with a dashed guide line and a tooltip that says "N values clipped above 10s". Make the chevron a focusable button that opens details.
rachel: Tooltip copy: change "p50: 230000" to "p50 latency  230 ms
raw: 230000 µs". Keep raw on a secondary monospace line and add a tiny copy icon. Ctrl/Cmd+C when tooltip is focused should copy the raw value.
jon: Smoothing: show a tiny pill in tooltip header when smoothing enabled: "smoothed  window=5m". Also add a quick toggle in the tooltip to temporarily disable smoothing for that hovered point.
kevin: Legend accessibility: collapsed legend must become a combobox on small screens. arrow keys move selection, Enter toggles series. Add clear focus ring.
a11y-bot: Checklist: make chevron button role=button with aria-haspopup=dialog, announce unit changes via aria-live, tooltip role=dialog when focused, ensure copy control is keyboard operable.
alisa: Nice. Next steps: Jon to mock unit picker + toast, Kevin to prototype chevron/guide, Rachel to write tooltip copy variations. Target: next Tue.
jon: I'll push a small Figma file and a prototype formatter snippet: `function fmt(us){ if(us>=1e6) return (us/1e6).toFixed(2)+" s"; if(us>=1000) return (us/1000).toFixed(1)+" ms"; return us+" µs"; }`
alisa: Great, tagging design board after mocks. Thanks! :sparkles:
